notes.title: Update Notes for December 20
notes.notes:
Heyhey Survivors! We heard your feedback clearly, so here´s a small hotfix to address some of the most significant issues. Thanks for the feedback!

[list]
[*] Increased Character Movement Speed
[*] Fixed a bug where enemy health in Stage 1 was using the Stage 2 modifier
[*] Updated Spellbook readability by fixing Dash and Ultimate Skills to the top
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for December 19
notes.notes:
* Rebalanced early game level-ups to provide Kagura's base ability upgrades earlier.
* Only Player-owned abilities are now highlighted in the spell book.
* Improved collision interactions between players and enemies.
* Enhanced enemy pathfinding behavior.
* Fixed blurry visuals for collectibles and destructible props.
* Fixed "Game Over" screen displaying incorrect gold and zero gold after full-duration runs.
* Improved enemy knockback behavior.
* Fixed dash not dealing damage. This is a temporary small fix; all abilities will undergo a damage overhaul in the coming weeks.
* Added total damage display to the "Game Over" screen.
* Fixed multiple collectible masks causing unintended behavior; duration now resets instead.
* Fixed main menu media playback stopping after one playthrough.
* Enhanced how Destructible Props are spawned. They spawn once now in somewhat random but hand-placed locations across the map. These props are shown on the mini-map and do not respawn until a new round starts.
* Fixed audio issues when reloading the game.
* Improved Kagura's damage mechanics to prevent multiple enemies from damaging her simultaneously.
* Fixed dialogue display bugs.
* Fixed max-level auto-select reward bug.
* Fixed Kagura's ultimate magnet causing unintended leveling during her ultimate scene.
* Adjusted stacked enemies to detach more easily.
* Updated slime audio to be less aggressive.
* Reduced character base movement speed to balance against improved enemy navigation and knockback mechanics, preventing overly easy combat evasion. This is temporary as we aim to give enemy balancing another overhaul, which will most likely speed things up overall to allow for easier traveling.
* Fixed bosses becoming non-interactable after player losing a boss fight.
* Resolved a bug where pausing during a boss fight could break the minigame UI.
* Fixed getting stuck in the Settings menu.
* Adjusted music volume to resolve low audio class levels.
* Fixed a bug where having the exact required gold amount prevented shop purchases.
* Corrected diagonal movement speed inconsistencies.
* Synced walk flipbook play rate with adjusted movement speed.
* Fixed closing the Settings menu also closing the pause menu.
* Resolved a number of "Win" and "Lose" screen issues.
* Updated Kagura's dash evolution to look more dynamic.
* Added outlines to characters and enemies for better visibility.
* Fixed closing Settings causing the game to resume.
* Moved the spell book to the center and paused the game when opened.
* Fixed inconsistent pause menu allow condition issues.
* Fixed abilities with zero knockback still applying knockback.
* Fixed a bug where pausing just before losing a boss fight allowed the game to resume.
* Fixed mods not showing which abilities unlock evolutions.
* Resolved a bug where reopening the restart menu after pausing caused UI overlap.
* Stage 1: Players can now move immediately without waiting for the portal to close.
* Moved the spell book to the center for better visibility. This is work in progress, we´re looking for feedback on spell book placement!
* Updated mini-map icons for magnet and gold.
* Resolved XP collectibles granting extra levels.

Known Issues:

* Some enemies remain stuck in their hurt animation.
* Enemies continue moving during their death animations.
* Spell Book placement isn't perfect yet.
* Attack Audio Hit Response needs more work.

notes.title: Kagura Survivors Huge Update
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Kagura Champions![/b] Thanks for surviving for as long as you did. We´re back with a big announcement!

After much testing in the open beta branch with your help, we have moved it to the default early access branch. For players and fans of the current early access version of the game, we are going to keep one OPT-INT branch open, which will allow you to continue playing the legacy / classic version of the game!

What will the switch bring, and what can you look for?

If you haven't played the Opt-In Open Beta branch yet, there is much to discover! 

We added 11 new enemies, giving the base game a hefty 25 Enemies overall. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/28416684c204258b32bd92951ab41885f06c5398.png[/img]

To create a more robust experience, we reworked and updated the ability system to allow fighting with 19 New Active and 16 Passive Abilities. You can combine these now to find powerful combinations to find powerful Evolved Abilities to fight with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/4a0eee31d4cc5bd7363c530f46e53d07e09e482e.png[/img]

All 3 Stages re-emerge with an all-new, even more beautiful look! Discover distinctive and unique points of interest while you fight off enemy hordes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/0b5bc04488d4d99750222284c9ae282f0810539a.png[/img]

Kagura 2.0! Your favorite mascot has been given a two-times-larger pixel upgrade, allowing for more expressive animations and even more incredible moments after style upgrading!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/09c67c8f0562da67ed5528284bcf183771e1b8c9.png[/img]

We even gave the UI and UX a complete facelift, with a new color palette that goes hand in hand with the rest of the game's art style upgrade transformation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/7a7d67ac306e3d466505b3629df133a067e486b0.png[/img]

Alongside the main update to Early Access and the inevitable 1.0 release on the horizon, we updated the Store Page to reflect the game's state and style better. Go take a look!

Finally, Let's talk about Achievements!

You now can get 103 Achievements in Kagura Survivors, compared to the original 47 ones. When you play your first round, get ready to see some new ones pop up. And the best thing? You will not lose any progress! Achievements already gained will be kept, and achievements still working on can be continued to work on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/ec910c70ae5142fdc4844b9bcf10847e2d1e2301.png[/img]

There are 5 Achievements you will only be able to get in the current build of the Early Access game:

[list]
[*] Goblin Boss Conqueror
[*] Gnome Boss Basher
[*] Item Collector
[*] Green Slime Boss Defeat
[*] Purple Slime Boss Victory
[/list]

These 5 Achievements will remain as a beautiful memory in the game's Version 1. If you want to 100% them, simply try to get them ahead of time, or use the game's property window to switch back to the legacy branch and get them while playing on that version in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/635a323970164fb5e041a991d98ec479c92f581f.png[/img]

We are mega-hyped to be able to do the BIG update to Kagura Survivors finally and hope that any of the changes, improvements, and other upgrades that went into the game will make it an even better time for you to play!

We´re looking forward to your feedback and voices in the comments, community hub, or Discord!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348120/Kagura_Survivors_Endless_Night/

notes.title: Dev: Kagura Survivors Beta Branch is Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Kagura Champions!

The wait is over, and the excitement is just beginning. We’re thrilled to share that the [i]Kagura Survivors: Endless Night[/i] OPT-IN BETA BRANCH is finally a reality. It’s been a journey of anticipation, and thanks to our team’s unwavering dedication, we’re ready to present this labor of love to you, our esteemed players.

To access the [i]Kagura Survivors: Endless Night[/i] OPT-IN BETA BRANCH, right-click the game in your Steam library and select Properties > Betas. From the drop-down menu, select the Public beta.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886091/89b2d255c2e23eadd983e81f567ac0c8671daeae.jpg[/img]

As you enter this new chapter, you’ll find we’ve woven in some small yet thrilling rescue missions. Just hit ‘M’ on your map, and let the quest to save the damsel in distress lead you to unexpected adventures. It’s a small addition, but one we think adds a whole new dimension to your gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886091/2b6d40affbae730cdec11bafd91e833730c51167.gif[/img]

But here’s the heart: this beta branch isn’t just about new features—it’s about us listening to you. Your feedback, which is the lifeblood of our development process, will guide us as we stride towards the official 1.0 release and the exciting content we have planned for the future. We’re not just building a game; we’re crafting an experience, and your insights are invaluable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886091/ec83ddc2ce9d3095972de8e6fc274de14eac9143.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886091/509d6a5b0b13b756cf9ea20597f9b53d73f4097b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886091/529ef83ae36b8c99d6cbbf05f42d314e69644346.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886091/c0443dcd1f819f7cd3cef38a32295602bf17685d.jpg[/img]

We’ve invested significant time in reworking [i]Kagura Survivors[/i] because we believe in its long-term vision. This first beta branch release is the beginning, with two more upcoming updates that will round out the game’s three stages. Over the next two to three months, we’re giving you plenty of opportunities to play and actively contribute to the game’s evolution.

We want to hear from you directly. [url=https://discord.gg/kaguragames]Whether you’re a voice on our Discord[/url] or sharing your thoughts on Steam, under the announcement or in the community hub, your feedback is the paint on our canvas. So, let’s dive in and make [i]Kagura Survivors: Endless Night[/i] the legend it’s destined to be.

We deeply appreciate your patience, your enthusiasm, and your unwavering support. Let’s make the magic happen, Survivors! 🌌

notes.title: Dev: Kagura Survivors Beta Branch Incoming!
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone! 🌠 🌌 Time has flown while we’ve been heads down, leveling up [i]Kagura Survivors: Endless Night[/i] with some game-changing updates. We’re almost ready to serve up the first slice of the action with our upcoming OPT-IN BETA BRANCH for Stage 1. Let’s look at what’s been in the works and what you can look forward to in the near future.

[h2]Beta Branches Explained[/h2]

For the uninitiated: Beta branches are like getting a backstage pass to the game’s next big hits. These unique versions let us share new goodies, tweaks, or whole new levels with our incredible community (yep, that’s you!) before they go mainstream. Eager to get on board? Keep an eye on your Steam library and our upcoming instructions on how to opt into the [i]Kagura Survivors[/i] beta madness.

The best way to share your feedback is on the [url=https://discord.gg/kaguragames]official Kagura Games Discord[/url].

Your adventure with Kagura is about to get much more epic, and your input is the secret sauce that’ll make it all come together. As we gear up to launch Stages 2 and 3, your insights will light the way to making [i]Kagura Survivors[/i] a legend in its own right.

So, hang tight a bit longer—the Stage 1 beta is coming mid to late April. We’re counting down the days until we can dive into this journey together and transform [i]Kagura Survivors[/i] into the adventure of a lifetime, with you leading the charge.

Strap in, get excited and stay tuned for more updates. The beta is just around the corner, and we can’t wait to embark on this next chapter with you. Let the countdown begin!

notes.title: Dev: Revamping Kagura Survivors Environments – Stage 1
notes.notes:
It’s no secret that visual appeal is at the heart of any immersive gaming experience. But achieving that cohesive look is often easier said than done. The environment, in particular, poses unique challenges and opportunities. We’re here to share our approach to reshaping the environment within [i]Kagura Survivors: Endless Night[/i].

[h2]Achieving Coherence Across the Map[/h2]

The first and foremost goal was to bring visual harmony to every corner of the map. This requires that every element follows the same graphic style and perspective. Since the environment serves as the backdrop for Kagura, the enemies, and all abilities, it must tie everything together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886091/33785f66fba8b6f9aa28122c63408d1c4137d864.jpg[/img]

Having a clear idea of how the sprites & ability effects looked allowed us to visualize how the entire environment should be. Here’s a breakdown of the changes we’ve implemented:

[h2]Simplifying the Tileset[/h2]

We noticed the previous tileset could have been quieter, compromising the sprites’ readability. Therefore, we aimed to declutter the tileset to align it better with the abilities and character sprites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886091/de15ba8a2760667589065af97e42041f84f6051a.jpg[/img]

We quickly settled on a plain tileset with strategically placed details scattered across the field. This simple design highlights the character sprites and creates a seamless visual experience.

[h2]Objects and Details: Less is More[/h2]

With the game’s fast-paced nature, objects with too many details can quickly become a distraction. We’ve decided to emphasize large shapes with minimal details rather than complex textures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886091/4807bc20e12525c26d5cc34bb8e00baa222c4c98.jpg[/img]

This approach keeps the environment engaging without overshadowing the main gameplay.

[h2]Enriching the Map: Exploring New Landmarks[/h2]

Our redesign is not just about aesthetics; it’s about enhancing the game’s explorative nature. While the map layout remains the same, we’ve introduced one or two eye-catching landmarks in each area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886091/9c41a08c163e77b7da5a5f00b61e1d5878dc967d.jpg[/img]

These landmarks enrich the game’s visual appeal and serve as navigational cues, making each area worth exploring.

[h2]Your Thoughts Matter[/h2]

This is an exciting step in our ongoing commitment to make [i]Kagura Survivors: Endless Night[/i] look good in every way possible. We value your insights and feedback as we refine the game’s appearance.

Let’s continue to evolve [i]Kagura Survivors: Endless Night[/i] together! Keep exploring, and stay tuned for more updates.

notes.title: Dev: Visual and Functional UI Overhaul Preview
notes.notes:
We’re excited to share a sneak peek of a major project we’ve been working on! A complete overhaul of the [i]Kagura Survivors: Endless Night[/i] user interface (UI). This isn’t just a fresh coat of paint – it’s a complete rebuild from the ground up, aesthetically and functionally. We aim to bring the UI more aligned with our evolving vision of what [i]Kagura Survivors: Endless Night[/i] should be.

[h2]HUD Rework[/h2]

Our HUD (Heads-Up Display) is getting a significant makeover. We’re incorporating new visuals and designs to provide a more immersive and intuitive experience. It’s all about delivering the information you need right when you need it in a way that’s easy to understand and doesn’t disrupt your gameplay.

The HUD now has an inventory button as a simple mechanism to hide the ability slots during gameplay to gain more undisturbed screen space. We’re also adding a spellbook to quickly access information about possible ability and passive synergy evolutions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/7fe91ddbacd1515e957bf1635ed315c647632297.gif[/img]

[h2]Shop Redesign[/h2]

We’re introducing a significant shift in the way our Shop operates. Instead of upgrading modifiers as in the old system, the Shop will now revolve around upgrading your character. We’re reworking its layout and functionality to make it more user-friendly and visually appealing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/b15677f47ff8c4d8d188b089e4b7285d8a44fdad.png[/img]

These are just a few highlights of the many improvements coming to our UI. We’re putting our hearts into this project and can’t wait to unveil the complete transformation. But remember, this is just the start, and we have many more exciting updates in store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/f76c15db3f5ed2620bf3fec30475c5c332bfcb62.png[/img]

We’re eager to hear your thoughts and feedback on these proposed changes. Your input is crucial as we continue improving [i]Kagura Survivors: Endless Night[/i]. Let’s continue to shape the future of the game together!

[b]Keep surviving, and stay tuned for more updates![/b]

notes.title: Dev: Planned Ability and Passive Rework
notes.notes:
Building upon the previous foundation of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348120/Kagura_Survivors_Endless_Night/][i]Kagura Survivors: Endless Night[/i][/url], we've taken the exciting step to refine and enhance the gameplay mechanics. While providing an extensive range of options, the original system of abilities, passives, and modifiers had shortcomings. This complexity, especially about the modifiers, led to redundancy and an overwhelming array of choices, hampering the player's ability to strategize and adapt in-game.

In response, we will merge modifiers with passives, significantly streamlining the system while maintaining diversity in gameplay. This change eliminates duplicate effects and ensures each passive contributes uniquely to the game dynamics.

But the rework doesn't stop there. We will introduce distinctive ability evolutions at each level, including synergy evolutions related to passives. This mechanic encourages players to think strategically about their progression, fostering a more meaningful and personalized play experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/284d2cdd41c46b34d3b0856459d923ee12924559.gif[/img]

To top it off, we're reimagining all visual effects for the abilities. The goal is to make each ability's attack pattern more distinctive, further increasing variety and enhancing the visual spectacle of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/ec9e8337502e61391441070d27dad0ae21ecbed3.gif[/img]

As part of this significant rework of the abilities and passives, we are also adding new and unique abilities to the game. You can see a few of them below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/33cc9b269ef71adad0bc4709074295808df6310e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/f480eec46716b4dd6f117947a61b8e9e1f9a103a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/eee0399cac3d080ba36e051ba60de3d8f68b8dbb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32398519/5897ec1fd434372537dd8e6f526279e04ca57c6b.gif[/img]

We believe these changes will significantly improve the strategic depth and visual appeal of [i]Kagura Survivors: Endless Night[/i], encouraging players to explore new tactics and strategies within a more streamlined, intuitive system. We can't wait for you to dive in and experience the enhanced gameplay. 

[b]Until then: Happy surviving![/b]
